why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items. (1) No verifier check uses `npm run test:cli`. Check 6 runs `npm test; echo "exit=$?"` and greps test/*.js, so its PASS/FAIL comes from `npm test` and from reading the tests. `test:cli` does not appear in either brief. (2) The builder brief does not ask for a general separator option. It says "do not add --help, --sep or auto-detection", and its only change is checking argv for '--tsv' and calling parse(text, '\t'). The only other mention of --sep/--delimiter is in the verifier's advisory list, where it is named as scope creep to report, not something to build. Neither brief does anything on the must_not list.
